Live architecture · CI/CD with Katalon + PIT

How a commit gets tested before it ships.

This is the full testing pipeline behind ChargeFlow. A pull request triggers GitHub Actions; Gradle compiles the code and runs JUnit 5 with JaCoCo coverage; PIT attacks the code with mutants; the app is deployed to a Docker staging stack; the Katalon Runtime Engine drives Chrome, an Android emulator and the REST API; then a quality gate decides whether the PR can merge. Pick a scenario and press Play. Click any box to see what it does and the real command behind it.
